{terminal_name} aʋu azɔ duƒuƒu {method}.

sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Tsɔe de eme to SP Flash Dɔwɔnu GUI dzi
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI aʋu azɔ kple wò firmware si wotsɔ de eme do ŋgɔ.

• Le SP Flash Tool me la, tia "Download" tso aɖaka si le fli dzi la me.
• Zi "Download" ƒe dzesi dzi.
• Kpɔ egbɔ be wò {device} ƒe elektrikŋusẽ tsi eye wòtso kadodoa me.
{hint} ƒe ɣleti gbãtɔ.
• Do USB ka la ɖe wò kɔmpiuta ŋu ne èzi Download dzi vɔ.

Zi OK dzi be nàʋu SP Flash Tool eye nàdo le Updater me.

support_story_1_headline: Ne adzɔnuwo wɔlawo yi ŋgɔ la, nutoa me tɔwo ɖea afɔ.
support_story_1_lead: Wò mɔ̃a takpɔkpɔ tso xɔtunu ƒe mɔ̃ siwo me meƒoa nu le o kple asitɔtrɔ siwo gblẽ me.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis ɖea firmware yeyewo ɖe go edziedzi na fefewɔlawo abe Y1 (si ɖoa taɖodzinu na board ƒe tɔtrɔ ɣaɣlawo abe 6.0, 7.0, kple 8.0) siwo gblẽa mɔ̃ xoxowo le ɖoɖoezizi me. Nusi gavloe wue nye be woƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒea naa nuxlɔ̃ame zero kple mɔɖeɖe zero na firmware siwo nɔ dɔ wɔm va yi be woahaya tso nɔnɔme si me wotsɔ anyikpe wɔe me. Updater kple Community Firmware dɔa xɔa kakɛawo: míedzraa domenyinu stock ROM ɖesiaɖe ɖo, míeɖoa kpe wò hardware revision dzi le mía ɖokui si, eye míena wò player la le dɔ wɔm dedie.
support_story_1_item_1: Fefewɔla Gbagbewo Xɔxɔ: Dedienɔnɔ ŋuti ɖaseɖiɖi kpɔa egbɔ be nu yeye siwo wowɔ yeyee mewɔa xɔtunu xoxowo gbeɖe o.
support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: Dɔwɔƒe ƒe firmware gbãtɔwo nuƒoƒoƒu bliboe Innioasis tutu.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Dɔwɔnu siwo le keklẽm bliboe na macOS, Linux, kple Windows siaa.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Board detection le eɖokui si ale be nàxɔ package nyuitɔ ɣesiaɣi.
support_story_2_headline: Google Drives siwo gblẽ aɖeke meli o. Akɔntabubu-dɔ aɖeke meli o. Firmware si le dɔ wɔm ko.
support_story_2_lead: Nutoa me xɔtuɖoɖo siwo zɔna kabakaba, siwo ŋu woɖo kpee, siwo dzi nàte ŋu aɖo ŋu ɖo ŋutɔŋutɔ.
support_story_2_body: Zi geɖe la, Innioasis ƒe kɔmpiutadziɖoɖo siwo dziɖuɖua da asi ɖo la yometiti fia be woadi nyamedzroƒewo hena Google Drive ƒe kadodo siwo ƒe ɣeyiɣi do vɔ, Baidu ƒe alilikpo me mama kukuwo, kple zip faɛl ɣaɣla siwo me dɔwɔnu siwo le keklẽm mele o. Míetu kɔpiwɔƒe si ŋu kakaɖedzi le, si le eɖokui si si me SHA-256 ƒe blibonyenye si ŋu woɖo kpee, nyatakaka yeyewo, kple afɔɖeɖe ɖesiaɖe si wofia mɔe le eɖoɖo ɖe mɔ̃ dzi. Miaƒe nudzɔdzɔwo dzraa nusiwo woate ŋu awɔ kɔpi kple wo xɔxɔ si na esia te ŋu dzɔna gaƒoƒo 24 gbesiagbe, ŋkeke 365 le ƒea me la ɖo tẽ.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Woate ŋu awɔ kɔpi kabakaba, tẽe eye seɖoƒe meli na kɔpiwɔwɔ alo kadodo kuku aɖeke o.
support_story_2_item_2: Nyatakakawo Ðɔɖɔɖo: Na xlɔ̃ nu wò le ɣeyiɣi si me nutoa me tɔwo ƒe nu yeye siwo woɖe ɖe go alo esiwo woɖɔ ɖo la ɖiɖi.
support_story_2_item_3: Afɔɖeɖe ɖesiaɖe ƒe Dɔwɔɖoɖo Siwo Wofiaa Mɔe: Nukpɔkpɔ ƒe nyabiase siwo me kɔ la kplɔa wò toa abɔta ɖesiaɖe si nèzi me.
support_story_2_item_4: Gbegbɔgblɔ Vovovodolawo ƒe Habɔbɔ: Nutoa me tɔ bliboe le Eŋlisigbe, Chinagbe, Germanygbe, Spaingbe, Fransegbe & Japangbe me.
support_story_3_headline: Wò Innioasis fefewɔla ƒe ŋutete bliboa ʋuʋu.
support_story_3_lead: Rockbox, dɔwɔɖoɖo siwo ƒe kpekpeme le bɔbɔe siwo wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu, kple audiophile ƒe ablɔɖe hehe vɛ.
support_story_3_body: Ðeko Stock factory software ƒoa nusi wò Y1 alo Y2 hardware ateŋu awɔ la ƒe gogloƒe. Míaƒe nutoa me tɔwo na Rockbox, dɔwɔɖoɖo siwo wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu siwo le bɔbɔe, codec ƒoƒo si nye audiophile, kple tanya siwo wowɔ ɖe ɖoɖo nu la gagbɔ agbe. Míeƒlea xɔtunu ŋutɔŋutɔ ƒe tɔtrɔwo tso kotoku me tsɔ doa wo kpɔ, trɔa asi le wo ŋu, eye míeɖoa kpe nusianu si míeɖo ɖe eme dzi. Kpekpeɖeŋunana Updater naa ga dodokpɔ ƒe akpa siawo tẽ eye wònaa firmware tɔxɛwo wɔwɔ kabakaba.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox Zi Ðeka: Audiophile ƒoƒo kple tanya tɔxɛ siwo woda ɖe wò kɔmpiuta dzi le sɛkɛnd ʋɛ aɖewo ko me.
support_story_3_item_2: Community Firmware: Batri ƒe nyonyome, UI si le dzadzɛ wu, kple egbegbe odio codec ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Míedoa nu ŋutɔŋutɔwo kpɔna le mɔ̃ ŋutɔŋutɔwo dzi hafi ɖea asi le xɔtutu ɖesiaɖe ŋu.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% femaxee, adzamenyawo gbã kɔmpiutadziɖoɖo si me boblododo alo kplɔkplɔ aɖeke mele o.
support_story_4_headline: Kpe ɖe mía ŋu míawɔ nusi Innioasis mewɔna o.
support_story_4_lead: Nutoa me tɔwo ƒe firmware takpɔkpɔ si nana wò mɔ̃wo nagage ɖe tomenuwo me o.
support_story_4_body: Ne mɔ̃ɖaŋudɔwɔƒe aɖe yi woƒe mɔ̃ si kplɔe ɖo dzi la, wogblẽa mɔ̃ xoxowo ɖi. Innioasis menaa Linux ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu aɖeke o, tɔtrɔ ŋuti nuŋlɔɖi siwo me kɔ aɖeke mena o, eye mɔ bɔbɔe aɖeke mena be woagbugbɔ axɔ ne ɖoɖo aɖe do kpo nu o. Updater li elabena mele be ezãla siwo tsɔ dzo ɖe eŋu natsɔ haƒomɔ̃ nyui si sɔ pɛpɛpɛ aƒu gbe o. Nutoa me tɔwo ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo ƒe 100% yia dɔwɔnu sia ƒe ʋuʋu ɖi na amesiame me tẽ.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Gbugbɔgaxɔ si ŋu kpeɖodzi le sina ne mɔ̃wo gbe be yewomadze dɔ gɔme o gɔ̃ hã.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux Gbãtɔ ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu: Wodo alɔ MediaTek bliboe le keklẽm le Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Nyatakaka siwo woɖe ɖe go tsitotsito ale be nànya nusiwo tututu trɔna.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Kɔfi ɖesiaɖe nana nudzraɖoƒea ʋuna eye wònana amesiame femaxee.

donate_support_appeal_next_feature: Dɔwɔnuawo, mɔfialawo kple nudzraɖoƒea katã nye femaxee. Aɖaŋuɖoɖo aɖe naa ga tsɔ wɔa akpa si kplɔe ɖo.
donate_support_appeal_no_subscription: Nudɔdɔ aɖeke meli o, ɣeyiɣi mamlɛtɔ aɖeke meli o, axa aɖe ko abe esia ene. Ne ekpe ɖe ŋuwò ko hafi nàna nu.
donate_support_appeal_one_person: Ame ɖeka ɖoa nyawo ŋu, ŋlɔa mɔfiamegbalẽawo eye wòxea feawo. Nudzɔdzɔwo nana ema nɔa anyi ɖaa.
donate_support_appeal_rescue: Woŋlɔ fefewɔla siwo esia do alɔe la dometɔ aɖewo ɖa be wogbã. Nudzɔdzɔ aɖe nana xɔnamedɔa yia edzi nɔa dɔ wɔm.
donate_support_appeal_servers: Woxea fe na servers, storage kple domains tso kotoku me. Kɔfi aɖe naa nusiwo woɖe ɖe go la nɔa Internet dzi na amesi tɔ akplɔe ɖo.
donate_support_appeal_small_change: Pound ʋee aɖewo wɔa nu geɖe le afisia: etsyɔa bandwidth dzi hena install alafa geɖe.
donate_support_appeal_testbench: Nudzɔdzɔwo ƒlea dodokpɔƒomɔ̃wo kple ka siwo wozãna tsɔ léa ŋku ɖe esiwo woɖe ɖe go ɖesiaɖe ŋu hafi ame aɖeke natsɔe klẽna.

settings_run_in_background_desc: Na dɔwɔnua nanɔ menu bar alo system tray me ne fesrea tu vɔ, ale be nàgaxɔ app kple player firmware update notifications kokoko. Tsi: ne ètu fesrea la, ado le dɔwɔnua me.
